D: Deadpool forms a team to protect a young mutant from a time-travelling soldier named Cable.
P: Serve the snacks when X-Force jumps out of the plane.
S: Fried tortilla rolls of shredded chipotle beef and cheddar
Shredded beef braised with chipotle, rolled with cheddar in small flour tortillas, fried until crisp, with sour cream and salsa.
Crisp fried triangles filled with spiced potato and peas
Spiced potato and pea filling folded in pastry triangles, fried until golden, with tamarind chutney.
the X-Force skydive that goes badly wrong

Popcorn tossed in melted butter with chilli flakes, lime zest and salt, a bit of heat and a lot of zing, poured into paper cones. Heat 3 tbsp oil and 120g popcorn kernels in a big lidded pot over medium-high heat, shaking until the popping slows to a few seconds apart. Tip into a large bowl. Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes and 1/2 tsp smoked paprika. Pour over the popcorn, add the zest of 2 limes and 1 tsp fine salt, and toss well. Squeeze over a little lime juice and serve in paper cones.
M: Russell, the kid in the Ice Box with fire for fists

Charred peri peri chicken thighs with turmeric rice and a crunchy slaw. Blitz the chillies, garlic, juice of 1 lemon, paprika, vinegar, 3 tbsp of the oil and a pinch of salt. Toss with the chicken and leave for 20 minutes. Simmer the rice with the turmeric and 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5. Cook the chicken in a hot grill pan with the rest of the oil for 5 minutes a side until charred and cooked through. Shred the cabbage and grate the carrots, then toss with the mayonnaise and a squeeze of the other lemon. Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the slaw.
Seared sirloin in a red wine pan sauce, oven chips

Steaks seared and butter basted, sliced with chips and a red wine sauce, candles on the table. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and roast until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks in a very hot pan, add butter and baste for a minute, then rest. Add 150ml red wine and 250ml beef stock to the pan and reduce until glossy. Slice and serve by candlelight.
W: Baked cheesecake on a biscuit base with raspberry
Cream cheese, sugar and eggs beaten smooth over a biscuit base, baked at 160C for 50 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with a glossy raspberry coulis.
K: Vodka, coffee liqueur and cold brew shaken until frothy

Cold brew coffee shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and a touch of sugar syrup until frothy, strained and topped with three coffee beans. Chill 4 martini glasses. For each drink, shake 60ml strong cold brew, 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 10ml sugar syrup very hard with plenty of ice for 15 seconds so it foams. Strain into the glass and float 3 coffee beans on top. Make four, using 160ml vodka and 80ml coffee liqueur in total. For a booze-free version, shake cold brew with milk and vanilla syrup.

Slice the mushrooms thickly and serve with the chips and sauce by candlelight.

steps.text: Blitz the chillies, garlic, juice of 1 lemon, paprika, vinegar, 3 tbsp of the oil and a pinch of salt. Slice the halloumi thickly and toss it through.
Simmer the rice with the turmeric and 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5.
Cook the halloumi in a hot grill pan with the rest of the oil for 2 minutes a side until charred.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the martini glasses in the freezer up to 1 day ahead; the cold brew keeps 3 days in the fridge, shake each drink to order

steps.text: Chill 4 martini glasses in the freezer.
For each drink, measure 60ml cold brew coffee, 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 10ml sugar syrup into a shaker.
Shake each drink very hard with plenty of ice for 15 seconds so it foams, then strain into the glass.
Float three coffee beans on top of each. Make it in batches of one or two.

Float three coffee beans on top of each. Make it in batches of one or two.

s.note: Fried tortilla rolls of shredded chipotle beef and cheddar
s.how: Braise 800g beef chuck with chopped chipotle and water for 3 hours, then shred. Roll small amounts with grated cheddar in small flour tortillas, folding in the sides. Fry seam side down until crisp all over. Serve with sour cream and chopped tomato salsa.

s.note: Crisp fried triangles filled with spiced potato and peas
s.how: Boil and crush 600g potatoes with 150g peas and a spoon of garam masala. Cut spring roll pastry into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles. Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp. Serve with tamarind paste mixed with a little sugar and water.

m.note: Seared sirloin in a red wine pan sauce, oven chips
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and roast until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks in a very hot pan, add butter and baste for a minute, then rest. Add 150ml red wine and 250ml beef stock to the pan and reduce until glossy. Slice and serve by candlelight.

w.note: Baked cheesecake on a biscuit base with raspberry
w.how: Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 500g cream cheese with 150g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs. Pour over and bake at 160C for 50 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with raspberries simmered with sugar and pushed through a sieve.

Strain into the glass and float 3 coffee beans on top. Make four, using 160ml vodka and 80ml coffee liqueur in total. For a booze-free version, shake cold brew with milk and vanilla syrup.
